XMLDB.COMMENT: W1-6 (2026-05-16) — HRMS sync runs + error log for 24-column Darwinbox/SAP CSV bulk import. ADR-032 (2026-10-01) — imported BizLMS history: earlier training records, login days, position and domain lookups

TABLE.NAME: local_sentientia_users_sync_runs
TABLE.COMMENT: One row per HRMS bulk-import event. Source: web upload or cron pull.

FIELD.NAME: filename
FIELD.COMMENT: Original uploaded filename for audit

FIELD.NAME: source
FIELD.COMMENT: web | cron | api

FIELD.NAME: costcenterid
FIELD.COMMENT: Tenant root the caller was scoped to (0 = siteadmin global)

FIELD.NAME: skippedcount
FIELD.COMMENT: Rows skipped because no change needed (idempotent re-runs)

FIELD.NAME: warningcount
FIELD.COMMENT: Includes pass-2 unresolved manager links

FIELD.NAME: suspendedcount
FIELD.COMMENT: Users moved to suspended state via employee_status enum

FIELD.NAME: usercreated
FIELD.COMMENT: FK to mdl_user.id of admin who ran the import

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: queued | running | completed | failed

FIELD.NAME: error_summary
FIELD.COMMENT: Top-level fatal-error string when status=failed

TABLE.NAME: local_sentientia_users_sync_errors
TABLE.COMMENT: One row per CSV row that failed validation or upsert during an HRMS sync.

FIELD.NAME: runid
FIELD.COMMENT: FK to local_sentientia_users_sync_runs.id

FIELD.NAME: csv_line_number
FIELD.COMMENT: Row number in the source CSV (header = 1, first data row = 2)

FIELD.NAME: error_message
FIELD.COMMENT: Pipe-separated list of validation messages for this row

FIELD.NAME: mandatory_fields
FIELD.COMMENT: Comma-separated list of fields that failed mandatory check

FIELD.NAME: severity
FIELD.COMMENT: error | warning

KEY.NAME: fk_runid
KEY.COMMENT: FK implicitly indexes runid — no separate idx_runid

TABLE.NAME: local_sentientia_users_transcript
TABLE.COMMENT: Earlier training records imported from the BizLMS transcript history (ADR-032, users). History only: never counted in completion totals. The raw text of every parsed value is kept next to the parsed one.

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: FK to mdl_user.id; 0 = no single account matched the employee id (off-platform learner)

FIELD.NAME: objectref
FIELD.COMMENT: BizLMS training_object_id, an identifier from the source system

FIELD.NAME: courseid
FIELD.COMMENT: mdl_course.id; 0 = off-platform training, so no foreign key

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: completed, inprogress, failed, notstarted, cancelled or unknown (the signed normalisation list)

FIELD.NAME: timecompleted
FIELD.COMMENT: Parsed completion date in the server timezone; NULL when the text did not parse

FIELD.NAME: costcenterid
FIELD.COMMENT: Tenant root of the matched learner when imported; 0 = none

FIELD.NAME: open_path
FIELD.COMMENT: The matched learner's org path when imported; NULL = visible to cross-tenant callers only

TABLE.NAME: local_sentientia_users_logindays
TABLE.COMMENT: One row per user per day with a web login, imported from the BizLMS uniquelogins table (ADR-032, users). Read only by the optional active-days report column.

FIELD.NAME: logindate
FIELD.COMMENT: Midnight (server timezone) of the day of the login

TABLE.NAME: local_sentientia_users_position
TABLE.COMMENT: Position lookup imported from the BizLMS positions table with the ids kept, because user.open_positionid holds them (ADR-032, users, gap G4).

FIELD.NAME: domainid
FIELD.COMMENT: local_sentientia_users_domain.id (ids are kept)

FIELD.NAME: costcenterid
FIELD.COMMENT: The BizLMS costcenter (organisation id) the position was defined for

TABLE.NAME: local_sentientia_users_domain
TABLE.COMMENT: Domain lookup imported from the BizLMS domains table with the ids kept, because user.open_domainid holds them (ADR-032, users, gap G4).

FIELD.NAME: costcenterid
FIELD.COMMENT: The BizLMS costcenter (organisation id) the domain was defined for
